name: phoenix-vscode
description: Shows your workspace, task results and error counts to Phoenix so Fawkes can react.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace the extension does not read a session token from the workspace folder.

phoenix.coreUrl.markdownDescription: Phoenix Core URL. Must be a loopback address. Empty: `$PHOENIX_CORE_URL`, else `http://127.0.0.1:4870`.
